title: nan
authors: Li Q.; Wang P.; Li X.; Zhang J.; Luo Y.; Yu W.; Cheng H.
key_contribution: Presents a formation-constrained cooperative localization scheme for UAV swarms in GNSS-denied environments using greedy node activation, Chan algorithm with AOA refinement, and gradient descent optimization.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
